verses.text: Around that time, John the Baptizer showed up preaching out in Judea’s wilderness.
His message was straight: “Turn back to God—the Kingdom of Heaven is right here.”
John was the one Isaiah had spoken about: “A voice is calling in the wilderness: Get the Lord’s road ready; make his paths straight.” 🛤️
John wore camel-hair clothes with a leather belt around his waist. Locusts and wild honey were his food.
People came out to him from Jerusalem, all Judea, and the whole Jordan region.
They were baptized by him in the Jordan, admitting their sins.
When John saw many Pharisees and Sadducees coming for baptism, he called them out: “You snake offspring! Who warned you to run from the judgment that’s coming?”
“Then live in a way that shows you’ve truly turned back to God.”
“Don’t gas yourselves up saying, ‘Abraham is our father.’ I’m telling you, God can raise up children for Abraham from these rocks.”
“The ax is already at the trees’ roots. Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit gets cut down and tossed into the fire.”
“I’m baptizing you in water as you turn back to God. But the One coming after me is way greater than I am; I’m not even worthy to carry his sandals. He’ll baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
“He’s ready to sort the grain with his winnowing fork and clean out the threshing floor. He’ll gather the wheat into his barn, but burn the chaff with fire that won’t go out.”
Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan so John could baptize him.
John tried to stop him: “I’m the one who needs your baptism, and you’re coming to me?”
Jesus answered, “Let it happen for now. This is the right way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” So John let him.
After Jesus was baptized, he came straight up out of the water. Then the heavens opened, and he saw God’s Spirit coming down like a dove and resting on him. 🕊️
A voice from heaven said, “This is my beloved Son. I’m so pleased with him.”
